business_summary: Mitsumura Printing Co., Ltd. engages in printing, industrial materials and electronic component manufacturing, and real estate rental businesses in Japan. The company provides fine art printing and publication printing, self-publishing service, high quality output service MITSU-ART, total solutions for arts and cultural projects, and history and printing techniques of fine art printing; commercial printing, antivirus printing, antibacterial printing, calendars, direct mail services, printing clear files, and anniversary projects support; POP and in-store promotional tools; and website creation, eBook and e-catalog production, video and film content production, photography and video editing, and AR content. It also offers digital printing and on-demand printing; original photo item creation service; digital archiving and content utilization support, visual archives, and document and book archives; newspaper printing and panorama printing; form printing, labels, slips, and delivery packs; anti-counterfeiting printing, CopiTect Series Anti-Counterfeiting Technology, Real Judge, and exam question printing and production solutions; packaging materials; shopping bags and boxes; etched precision products; and screen printing products. Mitsumura Printing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
